a:r.a:t: Rift has built-in Prometheus metrics that Mountebank doesn't offer.

You get request counts broken down by imposter and status code. You get latency histograms so you can see P50, P95, P99 response times. You get fault injection counters so you know how many requests hit your chaos scenarios.
These metrics expose on port 9090 by default. You can scrape them with Prometheus and visualize with Grafana.

This is valuable for understanding mock server behavior in CI/CD pipelines. If a test flakes, you can check whether it was a fault injection or an actual bug. If tests slow down, you can see which imposters are getting hit hardest.
